synthetic.label: Synthetic Baseline
synthetic.description: Industry-level synthetic data for the lighter supply chain. Derived from published commodity data, UN Comtrade, BIC Annual Report, and Wenzhou manufacturing estimates. Not tied to a specific company.

bic.label: BIC Group
bic.description: World's leading branded lighter manufacturer. Public company listed on Euronext Paris. Approximately 1.5 billion units per year; Lighters segment revenue $2.24B (2023). Phase 7 data from BIC Annual Report 2023. All other phases fall back to synthetic baseline.

generic_oem.label: Generic Wenzhou OEM
generic_oem.description: Representative generic lighter manufacturer in the Wenzhou/Zhejiang cluster. Private company; no public financial data. Profile derived from CLCA industry data, China NBS wage data, and UN Comtrade export statistics.

0.notes: Butane/LPG + PP resin + ferrocerium in situ -> liquefied C4; pellets; alloy rod stock. China is net LPG importer; butane feedstock price NYMEX-driven.
0.data_quality: Medium — commodity prices public; Chinese domestic feedstock delivery estimated
0.scope_source: Not available — upstream commodity extraction emissions not tracked to lighter unit level

1.notes: PP resin + steel + ferrocerium -> 30+ discrete components. 3,000 Wenzhou factories; $0.04 total piece-part cost. BOTTLENECK: lowest balance in chain.
1.data_quality: Partial — factory count and employment public (CLCA; NBS); individual costs proprietary
1.scope_source: Not available — injection molding energy intensity not tracked to lighter unit level

2.notes: Components + butane -> sealed assembled lighter. 400 units/worker/hour; FOB $0.10-$0.15. BOTTLENECK: second-lowest balance; opaque factory economics.
2.data_quality: Partial — FOB price inferred from Comtrade; throughput estimated from CLCA

3.notes: Assembled lighter -> ISO 9994 / EN 13869 certified. 21-day cycle; $2,500/SKU; 94% first-submission pass rate. Standards publicly available.
3.data_quality: Populated for standards; estimated for pass rates and costs

4.notes: Certified lighters -> containerized units. 2,000,000 units per FEU; $3,200 freight rate; $0.008 packaging cost. IMDG Class 2.1 DG documentation required.
4.data_quality: Populated for freight rates and container capacity; estimated for packaging cost
4.scope_source: Ocean shipping emissions: approximately 0.0002 kg CO2e per unit (estimated from IMO 2023 GHG strategy)

5.notes: Containerized -> customs-cleared. Highest transparency phase. UN Comtrade HS 9613 public data. US: 3B units/year; $0.15/unit declared value; 3.9% import duty.
5.data_quality: Populated — UN Comtrade; US Census Bureau; Panjiva (subscription)

6.notes: Palletized -> retail shelf-ready. 22% distributor margin (NACS); $0.45 wholesale generic; $0.90 wholesale BIC. Proprietary distributor economics.
6.data_quality: Partial — category margins from NACS SOTI 2023; individual distributor data proprietary

7.notes: Shelf -> consumer. Highest transparency phase. $0.89 generic; $1.49 BIC; 38% retail margin; $0.60 brand premium is PRIMARY E-LAYER FINDING (coupling ratio 0.60).
7.data_quality: Populated — BIC Annual Report 2023; NACS SOTI 2023; direct observation
7.scope_source: Consumer use phase: approximately 0.009 kg CO2e per lighter (butane combustion); estimated from 4g butane per unit
7.scope_quality: Medium — calculated from butane mass and combustion stoichiometry

8.notes: Used lighter -> landfill (>99%) or trace material recovery (<1%). PRIMARY CHAIN BOTTLENECK (lowest balance). 50,000 MT PP waste/year; 14,500 MT CO2e/year butane venting. No take-back scheme; no compatible recycling stream; residual butane = hazardous waste.
8.data_quality: Partial — waste volumes calculated from public production data; recycling rate estimated/inferred; no systematic lighter-specific waste data exists
8.scope_source: Butane venting at disposal: ~14,500 MT CO2e/year (10B units × 0.5g residual butane × 2.9 kg CO2e/kg). PP waste: 50,000 MT PP/year. Both figures inferred from production volumes.
8.scope_quality: Low — inferred from production volume and product specifications; no direct measurement

synthetic.interpretation: The lighter supply chain operates at 79.1% average D-C balance across 9 phases. Phase 8 (End-of-Life and Waste Management) is the primary bottleneck at 56.7% balance: a D-C imbalance of 215 vs 85 reflects a regulatory constraint environment (hazardous waste classification, no recycling stream, EPR gap) combined with near-zero circularity contribution. The manufacturing bottlenecks at Phase 1 (70.0%) and Phase 2 (72.0%) remain — the Wenzhou cluster's opacity and sub-cent margins are structural. The chain performs well at QA certification (85.0%), ocean freight (91.0%), and retail (92.0%). The secondary analytical finding is the BIC brand premium at Phase 7 (E-layer coupling ratio 0.60). The primary sustainability finding is Phase 8: 10 billion lighters per year entering waste streams with near-zero recovery, 50,000 MT PP plastic, and 14,500 MT CO2e from butane venting.
synthetic.key_finding: Phase 8 (End-of-Life) is the primary chain bottleneck at 56.7% balance. 10 billion lighters/year enter landfill with <1% recovery. Secondary finding: Brand-premium E-layer decoupling at Phase 7 (BIC premium $0.60/unit, coupling ratio 0.60) is the only meaningful abstract value in an otherwise price-compressed chain.
